shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | sort

for f in pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js "pages/api/posts/[id].js" pages/api/posts/index.js "pages/blog/[id].js" pages/blog/index.js pages/index.js components/AppProvider.js next.config.ts tsconfig.json styles/globals.css .gitignore GEMINI.md __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; git diff package.json
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | head -200

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && ls 02-guides | grep -i migrat; ls 01-getting-started 2>/dev/null; find . -iname '*migrat*' -o -iname '*app-router*' | head; grep -rl "getServerSideProps" --include=*.md . | head -20
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && cat 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md && cat 03-api-reference/05-config/02-typescript.md
cat 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md && cat 03-api-reference/05-config/02-typescript.md
grep -n -i -A3 'PageProps\|LayoutProps\|RouteContext' 03-api-reference/05-config/02-typescript.md | head -80

sed -n 80,115p 03-api-reference/05-config/02-typescript.md; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A25 'Page Props Helper' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A25 'Route Context Helper' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md

cat 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/index.md; echo ------; grep -rn -i 'deprecat' 03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md 02-guides/incremental-static-regeneration.md 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md 01-getting-started/08-caching.md 01-getting-started/09-revalidating.md | head -30
cat 03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md | head -80; echo ------; cat 01-getting-started/08-caching.md | head -150
sed -n 1,60p 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md; echo ....; grep -n -B3 -A30 '## Route Segment Config' 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | head -120
grep -n -i -A40 'route segment config' 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | sed -n 1,140p
sed -n 1,100p 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md; echo ......; grep -n -i -A6 'unsupported\|405' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md | head -40
sed -n 1,80p 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md; echo ......; sed -n 1,90p 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md

grep -n -i 'reset\|retry\|global-error' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | head -40; echo ......; grep -n -B2 -A20 'global-error' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | sed -n 1,80p

sed -n 1,60p 03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md | grep -v '^$'; echo ......; grep -n -B3 -A12 'title.template\|template:' 03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-metadata.md | sed -n 1,60p; echo ......; sed -n 1,80p 01-getting-started/13-fonts.md | grep -v '^$'

cd /workspace && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap'

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && sed -n 1,60p 03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-static-params.md | grep -v '^$'; echo .....; grep -n -A12 'Layout Props Helper' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/layout.md; echo .....; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 'metadata' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/layout.md | grep -n -i 'root layout' | head; grep -rn 'next-env.d.ts' ../../../../../.gitignore 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/.gitignore

grep -n -i 'metadata' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head -5; grep -n -A8 'export const metadata' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head -20; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/

cd /workspace && rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
.next/
next-env.d.ts
' > .gitignore && git status --short
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -60

(npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s -A 'SmokeTestUA/1.0' http://localhost:3124/ | grep -o 'Your user agent: .\{0,60\}'; curl -s http://localhost:3124/blog/1 | grep -o 'Comments (.\{0,20\}'; pkill -f 'next start'; true

npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|Error|✓|warn' ; npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc OK"; (npx next start -p 3125 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3125/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'; pkill -f 'next start'; git status --short; cat tsconfig.json | grep include
git status --short && grep include tsconfig.json && ls next-env.d.ts
rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && echo 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' >> .gitignore && git diff tsconfig.json
